212| class ProxyFallbackHandler(RequestHandler):
213|     """A `RequestHandler` that wraps another HTTP server callback and

229| def get_static_routes(static_dirs):
230|     """
231|     Returns a list of tornado routes of StaticFileHandlers given a
232|     dictionary of slugs and file paths to serve.
233|     """
234|     patterns = []
235|     for slug, path in static_dirs.items():
236|         if not slug.startswith('/'):

242|         if not os.path.isdir(path):
243|             raise ValueError("Cannot serve non-existent path %s" % path)
244|         patterns.append(
